messages:
ria: Quick UX check — on the compact dashboard the toolbar action group (Save / Export) collapses into icons and the focus ring gets clipped by the toast that slides up. GIF attached.

noah: Repro at 320px. The toolbar uses `overflow: hidden` so focus outline is visually cut. Also export icon is shifted into a dropdown which keeps tabindex on the original button.

tia: For the tokens, swapping `space-2` -> `space-1` helped visually but made the focus ring tighter. Can we expand the focus outline to 4px when `compact=true` so it still meets contrast?

omar: Alternative: don't change focus size; instead add `outline-offset: 2px` and ensure toolbar has `overflow: visible` for focus-visible. That avoids layout shifts.

ria: Toast placement: maybe prefer `inline` anchor above the toolbar when toolbar has `data-compact`. That prevents overlap on small screens. We could add token `toast-anchor: inline-toolbar` and fallback to bottom.

noah: CSS sketch:
```
.toolbar.compact { overflow: visible; }
.toolbar.compact :focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }
.toast--inline-toolbar { position: absolute; bottom: 100%; right: 0; transform: translateY(-8px); }
```

tia: Copy nit: current toast says "Saved" — for toolbar actions prefer "Preferences saved" or "Export started" when applicable. Keep it specific.

omar: A11y: use `role=status` + `aria-live=polite` and avoid programmatically focusing the toast. Also ensure collapsed icon has `aria-label` and visible label for screen readers.

ria: Acceptance criteria: 1) focus ring not clipped at compact densities, 2) toast does not overlap toolbar controls, 3) icon collapse keeps correct tab order, 4) specific toast copy chosen. I'll add Figma frames and label tokens `space-1` and `toast-anchor:inline-toolbar`.

design-bot: Reminder: drop before/after screenshots in the PR and add accessibility checklist.

noah: I'll open a feature-flagged PR after prototyping. Tagging eng-frontend.
